### Changed
- **model-manager ships with every installation by default, with no backend; the model-manager line moves to `>=0.22.0`** (giantswarm/agent-platform#329, bumblebee-plans#46 D3/D4/D5/D7, epic giantswarm/giantswarm#37639): `components.model-manager.enabled` defaults to `true` and the forwarded block names no backend — neither `model-manager.backend` nor `model-manager.backends` — so the release starts with zero backends (model-manager 0.22.0's zero-backend start-up) and backends are registered at runtime as labelled ConfigMaps (the `add_backend` tool, the portal's Serving page, cluster-manager for a GPU node pool; model-manager's `docs/backends.md`). The connectivity guards demand an endpoint only for a backend that *is* listed statically, so `backend: ollama` / `backends: [ollama]` without `ollama.endpoint` fail as before; the static forms render as before (the golden holds them equal). Model-manager's OAuth guard follows the muster guard's convention exactly: a `model-manager.oauth.dex.*` / `existingSecret` value that disagrees with `global.identity` fails the render (one login provider), checked only where both sides are set; a missing input is reported by the child release as for muster, so a render that sets no `global.identity` (or `global.domain` / `global.identity.issuerUrl` alone) is untouched. With `components.kagent` off the meta chart derives `kagent.disableWiring: true` for the model-manager release (it must not wire ModelConfigs into a kagent the installation does not run), with `components.muster` off `muster.mcpServer.enabled: false` (the MCPServer CRD ships with muster, so the MCP surface follows it; the REST API stays), and with muster's OAuth server off (`muster.muster.oauth.server.enabled`, the platform's one login — the lab shape of `examples/kind-lab-dex.yaml`) `oauth.enabled: false` (no issuer to trust, the way the muster discovery label derives from the same toggle); `tests/verify-components.py` asserts all three, both ways, and the two connectivity guards that failed the render for those cases are gone. Opt out with `components.model-manager.enabled: false`. The network policy for a backend registered at runtime is giantswarm/agent-platform#478.
